description.en: Planned fossil-form study featuring rounded whorls carry broad projecting spiral flanges above a long siphonal canal.
description.zh: 拟议化石形态研究：圆壳圈伸宽螺旋翼肋，下接长水管沟。

scientific_scope.en: Genus-level planning concept with a named morphological source; inferred anatomy and artistic simplification are separate from observed fossil form.
scientific_scope.zh: 具有具名形态来源的属级规划方案；推断解剖和美术简化须与化石可见形态分开。

distinctness.en: Its distinguishing construction is rounded whorls carry broad projecting spiral flanges above a long siphonal canal; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant.
distinctness.zh: 以圆壳圈伸宽螺旋翼肋，下接长水管沟为独立造型依据；须保留这些结构差异，不能仅靠换色、缩放或姿势区别。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly direction: establish rounded whorls carry broad projecting spiral flanges above a long siphonal canal in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以圆壳圈伸宽螺旋翼肋，下接长水管沟搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

uncertainty: Use Miocene E. gardnerae gardnerae as the reference anchor. Four projecting ribs are diagnostic; colour is not required as a distinction.
reference_notes: Period is representative, not a full range or a coexistence claim. Use Miocene E. gardnerae gardnerae as the reference anchor. Four projecting ribs are diagnostic; colour is not required as a distinction.

sources.title: Maryland's Official State Fossil Shell
sources.supports: Ecphora gardnerae gardnerae: Miocene fossil shell with four prominent T-section ribs and a wide umbilicus.
